description.zh:
API数据源ID，即**API ID**。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**数据分析** > **数据采集** > **数据源**页面，查看API数据源的**API ID**。</ph></props>

<props="china">API数据源的更多信息，请参见[配置API数据源](~~307003~~)。</props>
description.en:
The DataSource ID of the API data source, also known as the **API ID**.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **API ID** of an API data source on the **Data Analytics** > **Data Collection** > **Data Sources** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<props="china">For more information about API data sources, see [Configure an API Data Source](~~307003~~).</props>

description.zh:
上传到物联网平台的数据内容。JSON格式。
JSON中必须包含**ts**字段，用来表示数据产生的时间点（unix 毫秒精度的时间戳）。
description.en:
The data content uploaded to the IoT Platform, in JSON format.  
The JSON must contain the **ts** field, which represents the timestamp (in milliseconds since the UNIX epoch) when the data was generated.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 5.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot add-data-for-api-source --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n00000 --api-id cxatswiniekxw000 --content key_:_value_,_ts_:1637658200000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
